name: the-dropped-verb-is-remembered
pins: One request confirms one thing, and the cost of that rule has to be said out loud: a sentence asking for two verbs gets one of them, and the other survives only in the words. The note promises the patient may ask about the other one right after — and a template that makes a promise is the thing that has to keep it. So a refusal consults the memory, and only an exact yes acts on it. The department is named by subtraction: two desks are named, the kept half acted on one, and exactly one candidate is left. With the friendlier one-department phrasing this whole defect stayed hidden for a round.

turns.message: book me a dermatology appointment and cancel my cardiology one
now do the other thing I asked
